columns.comment: First day of the usage month.
columns.name: usage_month

columns.comment: Portal (e-banking), Payments API, Host-to-Host, SWIFT MT, ISO 20022, RTGS or FAST.
columns.name: channel

columns.name: source_customers

comment: Monthly digital-channel and payment-rail usage per client and channel from Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: e-banking portal users and logins, payments initiated (outbound, = fact_payment_transaction outbound count) and their value, STP payments, manual instructions keyed by operations (fax / paper on the network rails), digital payments, API calls and host-to-host files. All measures are monthly flows / counts (additive across months), except active_users (a monthly head-count - average or take one month). Digital share = SUM(digital_payments) / SUM(payments_initiated); manual share = SUM(manual_instructions) / SUM(payments_initiated). Grain: one row per golden client per channel per month.
